journey.geometryHashConvention: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON of ordered saved [latitude,longitude] coordinates; no spaces, no newline; number formatting must match.

applicability.message: Saved mapped-context preference comparison only. Matching route IDs or place names do not validate newly generated geometry, accessibility, operating status or personal safety.

integrity.verification: Pinned comparison SHA-256; linked Phase 5A artifact hashes; saved-route hash and route/profile consistency.

comparison.interpretation: Preference-based comparison of mapped measurements; no personal-safety recommendation.

normalization.correlation: Do not combine count, density and coverage into a composite. Do not add hospital/pharmacy subtypes to healthcare. Support is a three-dimensional Pareto comparison; a shared pharmacy never earns additive credit.
normalization.counts: Unique typed OSM records per geodesic route kilometre, with numerator and denominator retained. Descriptive only: density is sensitive to route/corridor layout and OSM segmentation.
normalization.coverage: Percent of projected traversed route length within 100m of category geometry; higher preferred when selected. Each category union removes overlapping proximity.
normalization.distance: Geodesic saved-route metres; smaller preferred. No sample-dependent min/max scaling.
normalization.duplicates: Keep raw records. Recompute coverage/count scenarios keeping all or one geometry per flagged component. Prefer only when worst-case versus best-case scenarios permit dominance. These are conditional scenarios, not probability bounds.
normalization.tolerance_units: metres for distance; percentage points for proximity; numerical equality only, not user indifference.
normalization.uncertainty: No imputation. Missing criterion makes that priority incomparable; zero measured OSM proximity means no matching mapped feature, not physical absence. Lighting, sidewalk and hours availability never affect preferences.
